description.value: Beaucoup Bakery & Café is an award-winning French pastry destination founded in Vancouver in 2012, celebrated for blending classical viennoiseries with Asian-inspired creations such as Peking Duck Croissants and Golden Mochi Croissants. The Britannia Beach outpost—on the Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor between Vancouver and Squamish—draws its design inspiration from the 15th-century tapestry À Mon Seul Désir. Cyclists stopping in can expect specialty pastries, 49th Parallel espresso drinks, and Bellocq teas in a thoughtfully crafted setting.

The About page states the Britannia Beach opening was planned for summer 2025, which has passed as of today (2026-05-28), and the Contact page includes an active Britannia Beach section—though notably no opening hours are shown for this location unlike the Kits and St. Regis locations. No amenity-specific evidence (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) appears anywhere on the website for any location.
